subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a first-class qwen plugin provider/auth surface, or should this stay as custom config/external plugin work for now?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but adding provider ids, auth choices, env vars, model defaults, and outbound hosts creates a supported user-facing contract that automation should not approve without maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Accept after PR review and repair
options.body: Review and repair the linked PR, then land it if maintainers want OpenClaw to own qwen-token-plan as an official provider path.

options.title: Keep custom/external only
options.body: Reject the bundled provider contract and close the linked PR/issue with guidance for custom provider config or an external plugin path.

options.title: Defer pending more demand
options.body: Leave the issue open as product backlog until maintainers see enough user demand or upstream documentation evidence to justify official ownership.

recommendation.title: Accept after PR review and repair
recommendation.body: Review and repair the linked PR, then land it if maintainers want OpenClaw to own qwen-token-plan as an official provider path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears in history as the original qwen provider owner and hosted-provider surface contributor, so this product-boundary decision is closest to that history.
